hands_off_processing: No detector execution or review before the final frequency check
unit: physical champion, with native champion IDs; Cassi and Issac remain separate
interpretation: Measured review flags and associations, not proven defects or causal effects
sample: Every actual champion turn start; actions retain exact engine step round/input/substep; group progress at round boundaries

D1.name: Stationary with no move, attack or cast
D1.predicate: At least 10 consecutive fully observed alive turns without movement, attack or cast. Exclude active channel, stun and standing on an available capture reward.
D1.denominator: fully observed alive champion turns excluding channel/stun/capture occupation
D1.limit: Camping or deliberate waiting can be legitimate. End-of-game incomplete turns are censored.

D2.name: Long high bag or high-bag death
D2.predicate: At least 40 gems for 50 consecutive alive turn observations without a recorded bank attempt/channel; separately, native death gem loss of at least 40.
D2.denominator: alive champion turns for bag duration; native deaths for death losses
D2.limit: Bank safety, map gates and deliberately waiting for a winning bag require contextual review.

D3.name: Repeated spatial or killer-specific deaths
D3.predicate: A native death within 250 rounds of an earlier death of the same champion within Chebyshev radius 6, or to the same identified enemy champion.
D3.limit: Same killer is not a measurement of an entire enemy configuration.

D4.name: Movement oscillation proxy
D4.predicate: A-B-A-B-A tile arrivals: four moves between two distinct tiles within 20 rounds; overlapping windows in one oscillation episode are merged.
D4.limit: Spatial proxy only. Hidden modes and target intentions are unavailable; tactical kiting can trigger it.

D5.name: Capture progress lost or reward taken after our clear
D5.predicate: An observed in-progress native group capture resets/switches owner before completion; separately, native last-clear team differs from native gem-reward recipient team.
D5.denominator: observed group progress transitions and native gem-reward captures, reported separately
D5.limit: Progress is sampled at round boundaries and can miss short attempts. Reward-steal coverage excludes any gold-only receipt absent from gemCollection events; native last-clear ownership is not damage-majority ownership.

D6.name: Waiting at empty camps or blocking respawn
D6.predicate: At least 10 inactive, unchannelled alive turns within one tile of a respawning group; separately, at least 5 turns occupying a group's spawn tile while its respawn timer is zero.
D6.limit: Spawn occupation measures a contributor to blockage, not proof of the sole cause. Waiting may be deliberate.

D7.name: Fuel exhaustion and native faults
D7.predicate: Exact native fuelExhausted events and diagnostic bot-fault totals, crosschecked against replay steps 26 and 27.
D7.denominator: fully observed champion turns; fault counts also reported per game
D7.limit: A fuel-out is not automatically a strength loss; zero-fault calibration cannot validate a positive fault example.

D8.name: Interrupted bank channel or observed lock
D8.predicate: A recorded tribute start ends without its native gemSubmission; report visible enemy altar-lock context on high-bag turns.
D8.denominator: recorded bank attempts; high-bag alive turns for lock context
D8.limit: No replay evidence exists for SDK calls rejected before a recorded action. Dynamic altar-path inaccessibility is not inferred from absence of banking; gate and failed-call diagnosis remains a deep-track task.

D9.name: Visible local isolation and ground-island context
D9.predicate: At least 3 alive turns with at least 2 actually visible enemies within 6 and no ally within 6. Separately record 50 stationary turns in a static ground component disconnected from spawn and altars.
D9.limit: The component flag omits ability, teleport and camp-clearing routes. It is a stranding review proxy, not proof that escape is impossible.

D10.name: High unspent gold and shopping timing
D10.predicate: At least 300 gold for 20 consecutive turn observations, including dead shopping turns. Record first native buy and actual equipment at rounds 100 and 250.
D10.denominator: all observed champion turns with known gold, including dead turns
D10.limit: High gold can reflect travel or saving. Equipment is an inventory purchase-cost descriptor, not combat power; Greed emblems cost 750 rather than 150.

D11.name: Turn-sampled vision gap and wards
D11.predicate: A native enemy-champion death whose killer was absent from all five preceding round-aligned victim turn-start visibility samples. Also report native ward placements through round 250.
D11.denominator: deaths with all five preceding alive turn samples and an identified enemy champion killer; ward counts only where game reaches round 250
D11.limit: Turn-sampled proxy: an enemy may become visible between these samples or in the death round. This is not proof the bot never saw the threat.

reporting.occurrence: Per-game any champion flag, separately for own wins and losses; n and Wilson 95% interval
reporting.time_rates: Flagged champion-turns / registered eligible champion-turns where applicable
reporting.uncertainty: Map-cluster bootstrap loss-minus-win occurrence difference; opponent-cluster sensitivity; report insufficient support rather than zero-width certainty
reporting.top_v_top: Reference only; paired teams from one game share a game cluster
